resources.string: Create password-encrypted backups, then restore them step by step: pick a file, choose a restore mode, enter the password, review the preview and confirm.
Every backup lists its categories, so the import preview can show exactly what the file contains, including sensitive content.
Set when you create the file
Sensitive content included. Provider credentials stay inside the encrypted backup only.
Included in every encrypted backup file.
Choose a file first. Then select Overwrite or Merge, enter the password, preview the changes and confirm the restore.
Every export is encrypted. Provider credentials can be included, so there is no unencrypted export.
Enter the password before previewing or applying anything from this backup.
Choose how to restore this backup
Overwrite restores every category found in the file. Merge lets you preview and include or exclude whole categories before applying anything.
Replace every category present in the backup file.
Preview the backup first, then choose which categories to include. Imported values win conflicts.
Enter a password before creating the backup.
Enter the backup password to continue.
Choose a backup file and restore mode first.
Wrong password, or the backup file is damaged.

Could not create the encrypted backup.

Backup created %1$s and saved as a .whisperpp-backup file.
Review the restore preview before confirming any changes.
Review the summary below to see what was restored.
Review the repair checklist below before relying on the restored selections.
Restore complete, some items need repair
Merge restores only the categories you keep selected here. When the same item exists on this device, the imported value wins.
This backup was made with a newer app version (%1$s).
This backup was made with an older app version (%1$s).
This backup uses a newer file format than this app supports. Some items may be skipped.
This backup uses an older file format.

Restore finished. Review the outcome below.
The restored provider or model is not available on this device.
Re-enter the API key for %1$s before using it.
%2$s: add the API key for %1$s, then select it again.
%1$s: choose a new provider and model.
When on, only redacted request headers are logged. Request and response bodies are never logged.
Changes apply immediately. Reset shows each first-use disclosure again the next time that feature runs.
Sending to cloud providers is allowed by default. Turn it off for an app to block it.
Block an app by package name
Recorded audio is uploaded for transcription.
Use Context is on. Recent text before the cursor is sent with the request.
Use Context is off. No text before the cursor is sent.
Transcript text is sent for enhancement.
Use Context is on. Context text may be sent with the transcript text.
Use Context is off. Only the transcript text is sent.
Instruction audio is uploaded for transcription. Then the selected text and the transcribed instruction are sent for transformation.
Use Context is on. Context text may be sent with the selected text and transcribed instruction.
Use Context is off. Only the selected text and transcribed instruction are sent after transcription.

Home shows your dictation progress, recent transcripts and anything that needs attention.
Finish the setup checklist first; Whisper++ needs the keyboard, the microphone and a provider.
Items under Needs attention link straight to the screen that fixes them.
Open Insights for detailed statistics. All statistics stay on this device.
Add providers here, then choose which ones Whisper++ uses in Default models.
Default models sets the dictation, enhancement and command defaults.
Keep model lists accurate so status summaries and validation stay useful.
If a provider is still selected, clear or reassign that selection before deleting it.
Choose the default dictation, enhancement and optional command models Whisper++ uses.
Pick a provider first, then choose one of its compatible models.
Leave the command override empty to use the enhancement model.
Per-language defaults can override these defaults for specific languages.
Set language-specific dictation and enhancement defaults when one global setup is not enough.
Add only the languages you actually switch between.
Each language can override both dictation and enhancement defaults.
If a provider or model is removed later, revisit the rule and update it.
Shape how enhancement behaves everywhere, then reuse focused prompt profiles across apps.
The base prompt applies everywhere unless a screen says otherwise.
Profiles are reusable prompt additions for app mappings.
Use App mappings when one app needs a different profile or provider.
Map individual apps to prompt profiles and optional provider overrides.
Choose a profile when an app needs a different tone or cleanup style.
Overrides are optional; leave them empty to use the global defaults.
Enter a package name for apps that do not appear in the picker.
Set the default preset for enhancement after dictation and for command mode.
The enhancement default applies after dictation when enhancement runs.
The command default shapes selected-text transforms before your spoken instruction adds detail.
Changing a preset affects the next run; existing text is not rewritten.
Tune how the keyboard behaves while recording, inserting text and giving feedback.
Automation options control how quickly Whisper++ moves from recording to insertion.
Insertion options keep typing behavior predictable across apps.
Feedback options stay on this device and do not affect your providers.
Control enhancement and the provider used to clean up dictation.
Turn on enhancement only when you want automatic cleanup after dictation.
Keep custom prompts short and focused on instructions.
Choose the enhancement model in Default models.
Review what data is sent, manage blocked apps and reset first-use disclosures.
Blocked apps never send anything to cloud providers, even when dictation works elsewhere.
Verbose logs only include redacted headers; request bodies are never logged.
Check this screen after importing a backup or changing providers.
Exports are always password-encrypted. A restore goes from file to mode, password and preview before anything is applied.
Provider credentials can be included in encrypted backups, so use a strong password you will remember.
Merge mode lets you include or exclude whole categories before restoring anything.
After a restore, stay on this screen to review skipped items, cleared selections and repair steps.
Insights summarizes your dictation for the selected period. Everything is calculated on this device.
Switch between 7 days, 30 days, 90 days and all time with the period chips.
The activity calendar and peak hours show when you dictate most.
Model usage and performance compare the providers you use for transcription and enhancement.
